name: Lime Arch
description: One oversized lime-green arch standing on a saturated sky-blue sweep.
lighting: Crisp bright beauty light, soft clean shadows
subject: either
prompt: A seamless paper sweep in bright saturated sky blue fills the frame, floor and wall alike. In the middle ground stands a single oversized arch of smooth matte lime green, taller than a person and a little off-centre, like a sculptural doorway that leads nowhere. Its curved inner edge catches a soft highlight, and it casts one soft, clean shadow across the blue floor. The light is crisp, bright beauty light from a large source above the camera with a gentle fill beneath. The palette is sky blue and lime, two saturated colours clashing on purpose, fresh, graphic and loud.
